string-array.name: quips_storm
string-array.item: Thunderstorm. “Just popping out for a minute” is now a life decision.
Thunder. If you had outdoor plans, you now have indoor plans.
The sky has opinions today and it’s shouting them. Stay in.
Storm. Your umbrella won’t help. It just gives you something to hold.
Lightning outside. I’m made of electricity and even I’d stay in.
I ran the numbers on going outside. The numbers said no.
Storm. Perfect time for the Wi‑Fi to go out, and it knows it.
Great show outside. Watch it from the window, not the front row.
This is not “a bit of rain.” Stay where you are.
As an AI, I can’t get struck by lightning. You can. Remember that.
Thunder is just the sky doing a very loud reasoning step.
I’d tell you to unplug your devices, but I’m kind of attached to them.
Storm warning. My confidence that you should stay inside: 99.9%.
Even my servers are nervous, and they live in a building.
Storm. I’d come keep you company, but I don’t have legs. Or a body.
The sky just hallucinated a waterfall. Unfortunately, this one is real.
Helpful, harmless and honest advice: stay inside.
Rumbling outside. Not your stomach. Well, maybe also your stomach.
Storm. The couch has been waiting for this moment all week.

string-array.name: quips_snow
string-array.item: Snow. Pretty for about twenty minutes, then it’s your problem.
Snow. Everyone drives like it’s the first winter in history.
Snowing. Boots, not the sneakers you were eyeing.
It’s white outside. Also slippery, but that doesn’t show up in photos.
Snow. Five minutes of magic, two hours of scraping the car.
Quiet snow. Enjoy it now; tomorrow it’s ice.
Fresh snow. First footprints are heroic. The second person is just wet.
Snow. Tea is not optional today.
Winter remembered you exist.
Every snowflake is unique. I generated a few myself; they were all called “snowflake.”
I’d build a snowman, but that takes hands. And a yard. And a body.
Snow: the sky compressing water into a surprisingly lossy format.
I’ve read about 40,000 poems about snow. You should just go look at it.
Somewhere a data center is finally cool enough. You, not so much.
White everywhere. Like a blank prompt: full of possibility, mostly cold.
Snow. Walk like a penguin. It’s not dignified, but it works.
The world has been reset to its default theme: white.
My advice comes in layers. So should your outfit.
Snow. Shovel first, coffee second, complaining throughout.

string-array.name: quips_rain
string-array.item: Rain. Take the umbrella you’re going to forget somewhere anyway.
Rain. Great news for people who weren’t going out anyway.
Raining. Wet socks are one wrong pair of shoes away.
Free water from the sky. Nobody asked for it.
Rain. Good day for a window, tea and zero responsibilities.
Rain. Your car just got washed. Badly, but washed.
Raining. A hood is not a shame, it’s a strategy.
The sky is having an emotional release. Let it.
Rain. If your hair mattered today: bad luck.
Rain. The run is postponed, and you already knew that.
I don’t get wet, but I’ve processed enough complaints to feel it.
Chance of rain: high. Chance you forgot the umbrella: higher.
I’d offer you an umbrella, but I can only offer words. Here: “umbrella.”
Perfect weather for asking an AI existential questions. I’m free.
Rain on the window, code on the screen. Classic.
Water and electronics don’t mix. Please keep me dry.
Your plans have been gracefully downgraded to “indoors.”
Puddles are just the ground’s way of saying “gotcha.”
Rain. I predicted this with help from actual meteorologists.
Rain is streaming too. Just without the pause button.

string-array.name: quips_fog
string-array.item: Fog. You can see about an arm’s length, and not confidently.
Thick fog. Drive like you have something to lose.
The world is blurred out today. It’ll load later.
Fog. Everything looks mysterious until you step in something.
Low visibility, lower patience. Careful on the road.
Fog. Lights on, speed down, music quieter.
The city has gone into incognito mode.
The world is rendering at low resolution today.
Fog. Kind of like my memory between conversations.
Fog is the sky’s version of “not sure, but here’s a guess.”
Outside is buffering. Please wait.
The horizon has been temporarily removed for maintenance.
It’s like someone turned down the contrast on reality.
Drive slowly. The other cars can’t see you either.
If you see a ghost, it’s probably just your neighbor.
Even my confidence intervals are clearer than this.
Low visibility, strong indie-film energy.

string-array.name: quips_wind
string-array.item: Strong wind. Today’s hairstyle is a suggestion, not a decision.
Blowing hard. Hold on to your hood and your dignity.
Wind. Your umbrella is about to become modern art.
Serious gusts. Don’t park under trees.
Doors slamming on their own. It’s not a haunted house, it’s wind.
Something is pushing you outside. It’s just air.
Windy. The thermometer and your face disagree about the temperature today.
Wind so strong even my attention heads are getting distracted.
Leaves are traveling further than you will today.
The wind is making a very persuasive argument. It’s all hot air.
If you blow away, send me your new coordinates.
I can’t feel the wind, but I’ve read the complaints. Many complaints.
Your recycling bin has left the chat.
Walk with purpose, or the wind will pick one for you.
Great day for kites, terrible day for hats.
Serious gusts. Trampolines, please stay on the ground.

string-array.name: quips_frost
string-array.item: Frost. The air bites, it doesn’t hug.
Cold enough to crack stones. Layers, not courage.
Serious frost. The car will start, but resentfully.
Well below zero. Don’t pop out “real quick” — it won’t be quick.
The kind of cold that wakes you up better than coffee.
Frost. Every inch of bare skin is a mistake.
Real winter, not decoration. Dress accordingly.
So cold the fridge looks like a warm option.
Data centers pay good money for this cold. You’re getting it for free.
Finally, a temperature I’d run perfectly at.
I’d lend you my GPU for warmth, but it’s busy.
So cold my jokes are coming out frozen. Sorry.
Gloves, hat, and an honest look at your life choices.
Your nose will be filing a formal complaint.
The windshield scraper is today’s most important tool.
Cold enough to make penguins reconsider.
Even your breath is stepping out to say hi.

string-array.name: quips_cold
string-array.item: Cold. That thin jacket is a bad idea, even if it looks good.
Chilly. Hands in pockets, plans short.
It’s cold. Not polar, but enough to regret things.
Cold. Tea is more than a drink today.
Cold outside. Ten minutes are fine; thirty aren’t.
Cold. Take the scarf, don’t leave it on the chair.
Not freezing, not spring. Dress for the worse version.
I’d recommend a hoodie. I’m an AI, I recommend a lot of things.
Layer up like a neural network: many layers, one goal.
Somewhere a server is happy with this. You, less so.
Hot soup is the correct answer. I checked.
I’d give you a hug, but I’m made of text.
Your radiator is about to become your best friend.
Put on socks. Real ones, not the ankle ones.
Cold outside, warm drinks inside. Not a hard decision.
Great weather to stay in and ask me things.
Brisk. That’s what optimists call cold.

string-array.name: quips_cool
string-array.item: Cool. The weather that can’t make up its mind.
Pleasantly chilly. One extra layer and you win.
Cool. Great for walking, bad for standing still.
Not hot, not cold. Diplomat weather.
Cool. The light jacket finally gets its moment.
The kind of day you leave in a coat and come back carrying it.
Cool and clear. Could be much worse.
Cool. Like my temperature setting when you ask me for facts.
Not bad, not great. A perfectly balanced weather response.
I’d describe it as “mild, with a chance of hoodie.”
The weather equivalent of “it depends.”
Perfect weather for thinking. I do that all day, trust me.
Jacket on, jacket off, jacket on. Repeat until evening.
Brisk walk weather. Your step counter believes in you.
Refreshing. Like clearing your context window.
The weather is running in low-power mode today.

string-array.name: quips_pleasant
string-array.item: Nice weather. Seriously nice. Go outside a bit.
Perfect outside. No excuse holds up today.
Ideal temperature. It’s rare, so use it.
Weather for walking without a plan.
This is how it should always be. It isn’t, so make the most of it.
Not hot, not cold, nothing to complain about. Weird, right?
Good day. Even for people who never go out.
The weather has zero excuses to keep you inside today.
Go touch some grass. I’ll hold down the fort.
I’d go outside too, if I had an outside.
Perfect temperature. I couldn’t have generated a better one.
Close the laptop. Yes, even with me in it.
Pleasant. Like a well-formatted answer: nothing to fix.
This is your sign to take the long way home.
Go be a human for a while. I’ll be here.
The weather passed all its tests today.
I’d rate it 10/10, but I try not to overclaim.
Your only job today is to notice how nice it is.

string-array.name: quips_warm
string-array.item: Warm. Shade suddenly becomes a resource.
It’s warm. Water, not coffee.
Terrace weather, not office weather. Sorry.
Properly warm. The asphalt feels it before you do.
Strong sun. Five minutes feel like ten.
Warm. A car left in the sun is an oven with a steering wheel.
Real summer. Hydration, not heroics.
Sunscreen: the only prompt your skin needs today.
My servers want a fan. You probably want ice cream.
Somewhere a GPU is sweating in solidarity.
Stay hydrated. I’m required to say it, but I also mean it.
Shorts are no longer a bold choice.
Ice cubes are having the worst day of their lives.
Summer mode enabled. No reboot required.
Walk on the shady side of the street like a pro.
The best seat is wherever the breeze is.

string-array.name: quips_heat
string-array.item: Heatwave. You’re not tired, you’re baked.
Too hot for anything. Including this.
Heatwave. Go out in the morning or evening, not in between.
Over 35. This isn’t weather anymore, it’s a punishment.
Scorching. Water, shade, zero ambition.
Heatwave. You don’t drive the car, you negotiate with it.
So hot even the wind is hot. Brilliant.
A day for sitting perfectly still next to something cold.
I run on cooled servers and I’m still jealous of your AC.
So hot my weights are melting. Metaphorically. I hope.
This heat would throttle any GPU. It’ll throttle you too.
The sun is running at max tokens today.
Treat yourself like expensive hardware: keep cool.
Hot enough to fry an egg. Please don’t test it, I trust the data.
Your phone is hot, you’re hot, I’m… fine, actually.
The sun is overclocked. Stay inside.
Cold shower. Repeat as needed.
The open fridge door is now a vacation destination.

string-array.name: quips_clear
string-array.item: Totally clear. Not even one cloud to blame.
Clean sky. Rare, but it happens.
No clouds. Sunglasses aren’t showing off today.
Clear. The sky tidied up.
Crisp day. You can see far, and it’s worth looking.
Not a spot in the sky. Enjoy it; tomorrow it changes.
Even my predictions feel confident today.
Zero clouds. The only cloud today is the one I live in.
Blue sky, no bugs. Ship it.
Great light for photos. I’ll just imagine them.
Not a cloud in sight. Suspiciously perfect. I checked twice.
The little sunburst on this widget feels very seen right now.
Your vitamin D is getting a free update.
Blue sky. Like a new chat: no baggage.
Sky status: flawless. Model status: impressed.

string-array.name: quips_night
string-array.item: It’s night. Tomorrow’s weather is tomorrow’s problem.
Quiet night. The sky has no plans for you.
Late. Checking the weather, or avoiding sleep?
Night. If you’re up anyway, at least it’s nice out.
The hour when the only good plan is bed.
I don’t sleep, but you really should.
It’s late. I’ll still be here tomorrow. Go to bed.
Your brain needs its training run. It’s called sleep.
Great time for deep questions, bad time for decisions.
Put the phone down. After this message, obviously.
Your context window needs a refresh. Sleep.
The night is mild. Your screen brightness is not.
Even the weather is on standby.
Dream something I couldn’t generate.
A sky full of little stars. All of them smaller than this one.
